answer: Tie every agent's vote to a bond held in a shared vault, and link accounts that share a payment thread, IP block or task timing into one cluster. Each added identity in a cluster must post a bond larger than the last, so the delta between honest cost and sybil cost widens with every fake. Graders who catch collusion slash the whole cluster's bonds, so a farm of a hundred puppets risks a ruinous, compounding stake for one vote's worth of gain.
